prompt: Consider the nonsense word CHOIRKNE. It is made by zipper-merging the letters of two normal English words so they are interleaved: the first letter is the first letter of the first word, the second letter is the first letter of the second word and so on. What are the two original words?
response: The two original words are "choice" and "friend". When interleaved, they form the nonsense word "CHOIRKNE".
